description: This PHP class 'LDAPAuthProvider' extends an abstract auth provider and implements LDAP-based authentication logic for the OrangeHRM system. It manages LDAP services, sync services, and authentication services to authenticate users via LDAP and handle related functionalities.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Implements LDAP authentication for OrangeHRM, extending AbstractAuthProvider and utilizing LDAP, sync, and authentication services to verify LDAP credentials and interface with the system's user management.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Provides singleton access to LDAPService instance, initializes if not already created.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Provides singleton access to LDAPSyncService instance, initializes if not already created.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Provides singleton access to AuthenticationService instance, initializes if not already created.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication for a user based on provided AuthParams, handles LDAP bind, and sets user credentials upon success or logs errors.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this auth provider, used for ordering among multiple providers.
